title: Hake Tikka Masala Pie
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired pie filled with tender hake in a rich tomato-based sauce.
instructions: Make the pie crust according to the recipe and set aside.
In a large pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato puree and coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the hake fillets in the pie crust and spoon the sauce over the top.
Roll out the remaining pie crust to fit the top of the pie.
Brush the crust with a little water and bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the fish is cooked through.
Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before serving.
